source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: A replacement order (new shipment) via Update Order and Make Purchase may only be initiated if the customer has been waiting 10 days or longer; waits under 10 days do not qualify for a replacement shipment.
The agent must record the number of days the customer has been waiting via Record Reason.
The agent is required to validate the purchase using username, email address, and order ID via Validate Purchase.
